four_floor.title: Beat and tempo; Backbeats
four_floor.supports: Quarter-note kicks with second/fourth-beat backbeats; common house/techno foundation.

amen_lesson.title: Amen Break drum lesson
amen_lesson.supports: Four-bar structure, repeated opening bars, internal snares, displaced closing backbeats and fourth-bar crash.

amen_program.title: How to program an Amen-style break
amen_program.supports: Ride eighths, kick doubles, dynamic contrast, later displaced snares, pedal hat; manually programmed timing is not the original performance.

garage.title: Everything you need to know about UK garage music and how to make it
garage.supports: Both four-to-the-floor and 2-step; syncopated kicks, backbeats and delayed sixteenth hats.

jack.title: Drum programming: Jackin' House
jack.supports: Four-on-floor with swing, ghost kicks and additional clap/snare activity.

techno.title: Hypnotic Techno Inspired by Phase Fatale's Love Is Destructive
techno.supports: Percussion-heavy repetitive techno production; our grids are independent studies, not the article's exact pattern.

grime.title: How to program 6 classic hip-hop, trap and grime beats
grime.supports: Grime's approximately 140 BPM grids, displaced/repeated/syncopated snares; trap hat subdivisions.

drill.title: How to make a drill beat with haunting, dark undertones
drill.supports: UK drill grouped 3+3+2 hats, moving snare, sparse kicks and portamento bass; not a universal rule for all drill.

dnb.title: 7 drum patterns every producer should know
dnb.supports: DnB two-step kick on first/sixth eighths, snare on 2/4, eighth hats with lighter in-between notes; house and funk examples.

jungle.title: Sully: Sketches
jungle.supports: Chopped breaks, pitched percussive dialogue and jungle rhythmic composition.

edm.title: How to make electronic music: the ultimate guide
edm.supports: Straight house/disco, broken electro, rapid jungle/DnB and spacious dubstep half-time; synthesis and arrangement also define genre.

rave.title: Lo-Fi House & Breaks Fusion
rave.supports: Combining break fragments with a four-on-floor kick, without importing that recording or tutorial MIDI.

dembow.title: What is reggaeton? How to make reggaeton beats that move you
dembow.supports: Dembow quarter kicks and displaced snare answers at 0.75/1.5/2.75/3.5 beats in a 4/4 bar.

disco.title: Nu-Disco: Live Groove
disco.supports: Disco-related acoustic groove possibilities include four-on-floor or a looser first/third-beat kick.

amapiano.title: What is amapiano music? Its history and how to make it
amapiano.supports: Slower house-adjacent percussive grooves, shakers and substantial bass activity. Our log-drum-style bass rhythm is an original study.
